statement: GT aircraft act as a control experiment that accelerates piston-aircraft ignition shielding/bonding/filtering and radio-noise acceptance standards; no discovery claim.
A6M benefit is lower ignition-noise / better intelligibility / installation reliability for existing radio functions, not fixed range/power or modern networking.
No current authority closes a general IJN fighter formation/leader-wingman/coordinated-firing reform. Historical-type tactical baseline remains.
Prior broad 'formation handling/section integrity' bonus is narrowed to fewer radio-caused communication/regroup failures; no generic combat multiplier.
FCS1 gives boresight/QC/re-zero/ammo-lot repeatability, not new fighter firing doctrine or coordinated formation fire.
Real gain is observer/report/plot/readiness/local handoff: detect->report->plot->alert->launch->coarse vector. No mature GCI/common air picture.
Type21 permits coarse warning/bearing/plotting/CAP vector only; no precision altitude/continuous fighter tracking/CIC.
Apr29 A14/A16/A18 replay must remove unsupported formation-doctrine bonus while retaining EMI/radio intelligibility, FCS1 and warning/readiness gains.
